title: Product noise agreement probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\beta$ be finite nonempty sets, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\beta$. For $0\le\rho\le1$, define the agreement probability as the expectation over a product-distributed input $x$ of the probability that $f(x)=f(y)$ when $y$ is sampled from the product noise distribution at $x$ with parameter $\rho$.
